newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - Telmex in record territory.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - Telmex in record territory.

text.p: Telefonos de Mexico (Telmex) was in record territory Tuesday amid heavy volume to stand out among American Depositary Receipts (ADRs).
Telmex was up 7/16 to 52-5/16, a 12-month high, in late morning trade. Volume was 1.8 million ADRs, putting Telmex on the New York Stock Exchange's most-active list.

Traders said Telmex was being boosted by positive sentiment about Mexico following Sunday's landmark elections. The long-ruling Institutional Revolutionary Party lost control of Congress for the first time in 68 years and a leftist opponent was elected mayor of Mexico City.
"The election in Mexico was not an event (after which) to sell, which some people were concerned about," said Lucia Skwarek, head of Latin American equities at UBS Securities.
"So the Mexican fundamentals are doing quite well and the (investment) flows tend to go to the most liquid stocks," such as Telmex.
Among other Mexican ADRs, bottler Coca-Cola FEMSA SA rose 1-1/8 to 54-1/8.
Brazilian telephone holding Telebras SA fell 2-7/16 to 159-7/16 after Bear Stearns analyst Rizwan Ali cut his rating on the ADRs to attractive from buy.
"It still has its upside," Ali told Reuters. "The only thing is that the upside from here onwards might not be that significant and there might be more risk."
He said factors weighing on Telebras included loss of market share as its subsidiaries are privatized and high capital expenditures for the next three years at least.

Smith Barney analyst Peter Treadway raised his Telebras price target to $180 from $165 for the end of 1998. In a report, he said in part that the Latin American telecommunications rally had further to go.
Shares in Canadian miners Barrick Gold Corp and Placer Dome Inc rose after they were upgraded to buy from hold by Salomon Brothers analyst Leanne Baker.
Placer Dome rose 1/4 to 14-1/4 and Barrick was up one to 21-1/4. The shares had fallen Monday as the price of gold hit a 12-year low.
Baker also raised her rating for Canada's Getchell Gold Corp to buy from hold. Placer Dome and Barrick were among the most active shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
Decliners led advancers 239 to 231 among 814 ADRs. The ADR group was up 0.07 percent and volume in late morning was 38 million ADRs.
ADRs allow U.S. trade of foreign stocks.
